VERDICT goal: the node goal is "Solve WEST 62751's iron through the production reader and material solve at two mesh sizes"; scripts/west_iron_solve/measure.py:223-343 attempts that pair and refuses its own result at :296, so what landed is the Newton-stall diagnosis that the resumed brief (resume-3-advice.txt) substituted for acceptance, and no two-mesh solve, converged mu_r figure, Picard control or discretisation error bar exists in the tree.
VERDICT done_when: done_when clause (1) -- convergence at 0.08 m and 0.04 m in at most ten Newton iterations with every mu_r inside the table, plus a frozen-permeability Picard run recorded failing -- is asserted by no gate that ran: measure.py:296 asserts exactly that and is never reached with a converged row, probe.py records the 0.08 m mesh refused outright, and the gate that did run (diagnose.sbatch, EXIT=0 in diagnostic.log at revision 2bc1f557f) measures the diagnosis instead; the manifest states the ten-iteration gate "remains unmet" rather than claiming it.
VERDICT write_paths: the dispatch names scripts/west_iron_solve, docs/evidence/fragments/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-west-62751-solve.html and docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-west-62751-solve; all twelve commits 97be7b243 through a6d9a38e3 touch only those three roots, and no nova/ or tests/ path appears in any of them.
VERDICT manifest: read at the reviewed run's manifest.md; status complete with twelve shas, the diagnose.sbatch command and diagnostic.log named, and module_sha256 4507b806f8eeca9d1c459c3af21e0095d5a17d52c59e53822ba6bcb1abe6b6ab which I recomputed and found identical at both 2bc1f557f and a6d9a38e3, and it states the original ten-iteration mesh-pair gate remains unmet rather than reporting success.
